name: Apagy (Hungary)
description: A vertical medium blue banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Apagy (a green shield with a yellow charge, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) between the words APAGY above and KÖZSÉG below in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Apagy arms with helm, crest and mantling
